# Barcelona.com

> > Your comprehensive guide to Barcelona, Spain — featuring Antoni Gaudí's masterpieces, FC Barcelona football, and Catalan culture.

Barcelona.com is the definitive travel resource for visitors to Barcelona, covering iconic landmarks like Sagrada Família and Park Güell, practical travel information, FC Barcelona tickets and stadium tours, and day trips to Costa Brava. The site specializes in UNESCO World Heritage sites, modernist architecture, and booking tickets for Barcelona's top attractions.

## Key Topics

- Antoni Gaudí architecture
- Sagrada Família basilica
- Park Güell
- Casa Batlló
- FC Barcelona & Camp Nou
- Modernist architecture
- UNESCO World Heritage sites
- Eixample district
- Costa Brava day trips
- Las Ramblas
- Palau de la Música Catalana
- Catalonia & Catalan culture
- Barcelona attraction tickets
- La Liga football matches
- Cadaqués & coastal villages

## Gaudí & Modernist Architecture

- [Sagrada Família Barcelona Spain - History & Architecture](https://www.barcelona.com/barcelona-attractions/sagrada-familia): Sagrada Família: Gaudí's UNESCO basilica history, facades & interior
- [Casa Vicens Tickets | Barcelona.com](https://www.barcelona.com/barcelona-attractions/casa-vicens): Casa Vicens tickets: Gaudí's first major work & UNESCO heritage site
- [La Casa Calvet of Antoni Gaudi in Barcelona](https://www.barcelona.com/barcelona-attractions/casa-calvet-gaudi): Casa Calvet: Gaudí's modernist building in Eixample with restaurant
- [The Catalan Music Palace - Palau de la Música Catalana in Barcelona](https://www.barcelona.com/barcelona-attractions/music-palace): Palau de la Música: UNESCO modernist concert hall with guided tours
- [Sant Pau Hospital Barcelona](https://www.barcelona.com/barcelona-attractions/sant-pau-hospital-barcelona): Sant Pau: UNESCO modernist hospital complex by Domènech i Montaner

## Historic Landmarks & Cultural Sites

- [Gran Teatre del Liceu in Barcelona](https://www.barcelona.com/barcelona-attractions/gran-teatre-del-liceu): Gran Teatre del Liceu: Barcelona's historic opera house on Las Ramblas
- [The Christopher Columbus Monument in Barcelona > Lift ticket](https://www.barcelona.com/barcelona-attractions/monument-of-christopher-columbus): Columbus Monument: 1888 landmark with observation deck lift tickets
- [The Church of Betlem, a Baroque jewel in Barcelona.](https://www.barcelona.com/barcelona-attractions/church-betlem): Church of Betlem: Baroque Jesuit church on Las Ramblas
